messages:
ashley: Heads-up — PR #8421 is blocking the 11:00 cutover, need 2x LGTM before 10:15 (45m). CI is green except one flaky e2e. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/8421
kevin: on it, will try to do a quick pass in 10m
li: I can give one LGTM after smoke locally, ping me when CI is green again
devbot: CI: ✅ build; ✅ unit; ❌ e2e (flaky-test-timeout). Artifacts: https://ci.example/8421
jordan: looks like the e2e failure is the same as yesterday. I can rerun and triage but wont finish before cutoff
ashley: we can't delay the cutover; need fallback plan. If we get 2 approvals we can merge and monitor. @sam could you hold the other approver lane?
sam: I can take second approve if code is small. Quick checklist: 1) no DB schema changes 2) no traffic-affecting toggle 3) performance regression check logs
ashley: no schema changes, toggle is behind feature flag, perf looks fine in canary. Here's the main change: `kv-cache ttl fix` — tiny change in runtime.
kevin: skimmed diffs, lgtm pending small nit (docstring). I'll push a one-line fix and approve after CI passes.
li: saw the nit, approved the change diff-wise. leaving comment about adding test later :thumbsup:
devbot: CI re-run started by @kevin — build queued
devbot: CI: ✅ build; ✅ unit; ✅ e2e — flake cleared
kevin: pushed fix and added LGTM
sam: giving 2nd LGTM. merging after deploy window check.
ashley: thank you all. I'll schedule merge at 10:05 and coordinate rollback window. If anything, react with :bangbang: in this thread.
jordan: quick note — I'll watch post-deploy metrics and be on pager for 30m
ashley: perfect. closing thread after cutover. :rocket:
